purpose: Recover clean inventory from Stage6 quarantine before any new sourcing, then classify residual rails into evidence-blocked versus true source gaps.
rules: Existing source count is not shelf truth.
Only Stage6 quarantine products may be recovered.
No Stage6 SAFE MOVE is overridden.
Recovery KEEP requires independent supplier taxonomy or explicit product-type evidence.
REVIEW, UNKNOWN and HOLD remain quarantined.
New sourcing begins only after recovery is exhausted or insufficient.
Every newly sourced product must re-enter Product Placement Gate before quality, stock, shipping and profit gates.
Shelf density never overrides placement truth.
